title: Obeya suggests card labels
text: When a card's category, sub-category, complexity or priority is left empty, Obeya now suggests a value. A card without a title gets its labels in the same short call that names it. A card with a title gets one quick call when it starts, which never holds up the start. Labels you set yourself are never touched or asked for again, and a canvas can turn off the labels it doesn't want suggested. The table shows the real suggestions for a handful of sample cards.
